semanticChanges.change: Historical agent-history tail: ZIP stored/deflate import, split upload join and text sniffing, safe relative names; optional Node zstd log decoding; provider-aware token-cost formulas; summaries, tables, patterns and timeline CLI. Whole historical file is larger than this group; prefix belongs to another group.
semanticChanges.contracts: PART_RE accepts numbered/lettered byte splits; refuses zip-s spanned sets. No CRC/Zip64 checking shown; ZIP imports recurse. Cost unknown without tokens/prices. Timeline output labels records DATA, not instructions.
semanticChanges.consumers: CLI users, digest/report workflows; upstream digestText/group data shapes are outside assigned tail.

semanticChanges.change: Entire historical messaging CLI absent current: webhook plus bus mirror and optional per-letter routine relay.
semanticChanges.contracts: Typed INFO/QUESTION/READY/HANDOFF/INCIDENT/REQUEST/ROTATE/LEND/RETURN/TRANSFER; READY receipt by default; body/address checks precede remote send. Bus written before relay/webhook. HTTPS relay only; up to two retries only for 429/5xx, retry-after at most 120s, no retry on ambiguous network failure. Missing webhook env may still succeed with bus. Dry-run still prints payload; secret redaction is error-oriented, not a blanket data sanitizer.
semanticChanges.consumers: fleet-bus shared sendBusLine, gate-receipt readiness, configured routine/webhook receiver; stale warning reads latest local bus window.

semanticChanges.change: Current references Coordination and retired claims board; historical comment references Concurrent PRs / who-is-on-it.
semanticChanges.contracts: Comment-only provenance, not changed runtime inferred from these spans.

semanticChanges.change: Current strictFlags replaces help-only parsing; unknown flags exit 2; current roster includes bitmap worker because client now uses ScriptLoader.url. Historical excluded worker to retain build-keyed precache.
semanticChanges.consumers: cache/version tag auditor and staged release output; roster manifest, bitmap worker client and service worker must agree.

semanticChanges.change: Current exports usage/known-flags and validates only entrypoint invocation, allowing importing tools to carry independent argv. Historical exitIfHelp runs at import.
semanticChanges.consumers: CI watch CLI and importers; historic dashboard importer explicitly deferred import because help handling read argv.

semanticChanges.change: Entire historical Claude JSONL usage digester absent current.
semanticChanges.contracts: Dedup by requestId/message.id with maxima per counter; dedup resumed turns by uuid; meta and tool-results do not open turns; sidechain separate; missing counters unknown. Host origin preferred over envelope inference. Low-tool wake proxy cannot establish waste or billing; transcript/per-turn outputs private, not committed.
semanticChanges.consumers: local transcript files/directories/stdin-independent CLI input; optional --turns/--json.

semanticChanges.change: Current steward tag; env-name allowlist and MCP-host allowlist added; interpolation records names in nonenumerable envRefs, launch/followup logs names only. Historical interpolation allowed arbitrary available names.
semanticChanges.contracts: Current allowed sources APEX_FLEET_AS, APEX_SESSION_ID, APEX_AGENT_WEBHOOK_URL, APEX_AGENT_WEBHOOK_AUTH, CURSOR_API_KEY; remote hosts Cursor API, GitHub/subdomains or configured webhook host. Current changes read as differing text, not executed.

semanticChanges.change: Current git helpers delegated to git-run/gitMust and strict flag validation occurs before fetch/log/merge; usage is derived from marked header instead of a fixed slice.
semanticChanges.consumers: deploy command protocol and library extraction.

semanticChanges.change: Current tally also parses node FAIL/TAP blocks and broadens browser classification to staged jobs; historical only browser logs. Current quarantine proposals filter to Playwright specs, leaving node repeats as fixes.
semanticChanges.contracts: Node failures are first-try fail events, no assumed retry. Tally retains owner/evidence contract; comment now names Coordination.

semanticChanges.change: Entire historical archive planner absent current.
semanticChanges.contracts: Saved list_sessions page is data. ARCHIVE requires agent-created eligible role, idle >=60min, no running/no-archive/in-flight summary, every named PR closed/merged. Retired orchestrator requires distinct LIVE successor; unknown/offline keeps. Tool only prints decisions, never archives.
semanticChanges.consumers: session operator, gh PR state, fleet-bus successor discovery.

semanticChanges.change: Entire historical six-dataset dashboard snapshot utility absent current.
semanticChanges.contracts: prs,bus,claims,deploy,derived,snapshot; per-source errors produce empty dataset/error metadata and nonzero partial verdict. Default 25 PRs, 40 bus entries, claims 120min. API file list first page can limit classification. --no-fetch does not disable REST or ls-remote.
semanticChanges.consumers: dashboard JSON datasets; ci-watch verdict, pr-board status, claims board and fleet bus.

semanticChanges.change: Entire historical issue board/claimed-label reconciler absent current.
semanticChanges.contracts: Preview default; --apply writes labels/comments/pinned issue. Associations differ from ownership; merged references do not prove completion. API or claim incompleteness aborts before writes; nested timeline/closing-link pagination limit fails closed. Read-only retries only HTTP 502/503/504.
semanticChanges.consumers: fleet workflow and phone board; claims board, issue timeline, closing references, labels manifest.

semanticChanges.change: Entire historical brief generator absent current.
semanticChanges.contracts: 2048-byte compact JSON and <=40-line Markdown; removes bus, board, shortens texts, drops lanes/asks and records drops. Disk newline means bytes cap applies JSON.stringify, not complete written file. Header advertises --queue-md/launch-policy budget behavior absent from implemented VALUE set and main: documentation is ahead of implementation in this snapshot.
semanticChanges.consumers: successor handoff from queue, saved pr-board, bus/cursor and explicit triggers/asks; data hint never authority.

semanticChanges.change: Entire historical PR bus-comment mirror absent current.
semanticChanges.contracts: Only to:#digits, open PRs; short-sha comment markers dedupe; default last200/24h when no known cursor; closed/merged skipped. API lookup failure treated not-PR, post errors counted; no transactional cursor update shown.

semanticChanges.change: Entire historical bus/lease implementation absent current; current WORKERS explicitly retires it 2026-10-27.
semanticChanges.contracts: Branch commit subjects typed messages; lease.json tree; fast-forward compare-and-swap with five tries and object-id guard against deletion refspec. Protocol body20-600 chars, send allowlisted types/flags/address; dedupe last200, automatic READY/DONE keys, DONE across senders. Read default skips hidden lines, strict preserves at-least-once boundary, peek no cursor; watch seen500 and interval5-600s suppresses foreign broadcast train chatter. LIVE requires self or ROTATE; stale45min based last own line. Leases default60/max240min; break requires recorded user grant.
semanticChanges.consumers: agent-msg, archive, brief, mirror, dashboard and ownership utilities; ready receipts, claims dispatch and local cursor files.

semanticChanges.change: Entire historical session flag formatter absent current.
semanticChanges.contracts: Saved get_session/ccr data; defaults cost15,context300000,stale30min; explicit cost overrides metadata; missing values null, configured/served normalized; working-disconnected/stale flags. Exit0 always, no action or network; flags are evidence prompts.

semanticChanges.change: Only first10160 historical bytes assigned here; current utility absent. Tail and complete ownership resolution belong to another group.
semanticChanges.contracts: Prefix defines HELD open-diff > live CLAIMED > FREE precedence, release-answer prints only, path/glob/directory matching, caller claim identity, fleet-block owner fallback, paginated open PR listing and start of files API enumeration. Header promises local three-dot diff/cache/parallel API fail-closed behavior; implementation beyond prefix not certified here.
semanticChanges.consumers: push guard/path coordination historically; current root retains open-PR ownership rule but uses GitHub coordination.
